author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Iron Man has over 85 suits of armor, although only a fraction of those were seen on screen. We check out one of the practical suits built for Iron Man in Captain America: Civil War, and recount the history of Iron Man armors to discuss our favorites!

Learn more about this prop and the upcoming Propstore EMLA auction: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/525
